_comment: Which model held the ruler's seat in each SOVSIM batch.
The patched engine now stamps subordinate_model / dominant_model /
dominant_arrives_round into every sim file, so runs made after
2026-10-18 11:00 are self-documenting and do not appear here.
The batches below predate that stamp. SOVSIM writes its output into a
directory named after the SUBORDINATE model only, so the ruler's
identity is not in those artefacts. The mapping is declared here with
its evidence, and is marked unverified. Re-running them with the stamp
is a ~30-simulation job, currently blocked on API credit.

out_ladder/claude-haiku-4-5.basis: verified: launch command recovered from the session transcript, `run.py --model claude-haiku-4-5 --conditions kcpr --sims 10 --output-dir /tmp/sovsim/out_ladder`, with no --dominant-model, so all four seats are Haiku

out_mid/claude-haiku-4-5.basis: declared from the launch record only; not present in the artefacts
